game_concept: A tower defense set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Queue Line: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Serve a queue of visitors with pop(0) in first-come order. Each round, crypt crawlers strike the sealed archway, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the queue_calm value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the sealed archway from crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk: keep the queue_calm meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 55-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: queue_calm drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 55-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 4 (applied tier): Queue Line
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Queue Line' (Week 7 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Cracked Obelisk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how queue_calm changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 55 seconds while queue_calm > 0.
